recognize_zh: 低倍血片中紅血球不規則地黏成大小不一的團塊（紅血球凝集，非串錢狀），同時散布大量中型淋巴樣細胞、染色質中度濃縮、胞質少至中等，提示淋巴增生疾病（本例為前淋巴球白血病）合併冷凝集素溶血。
features: Irregular three-dimensional clumps of red cells of variable size (agglutination) rather than linear rouleaux stacks
Increased medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Some lymphoid cells with a suggestion of a central nucleolus, not well resolved at this magnification
Occasional small dense red cells (possible spherocytes) between clumps
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent red cell agglutination with irregular clumps of erythrocytes of varying size. There is an increase in medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and a modest rim of pale cytoplasm; nucleoli are not clearly resolved at this magnification. Occasional dense spherocyte-like cells are present. Findings are consistent with cold agglutinin-mediated hemolysis associated with a lymphoproliferative disorder; in this patient flow cytometry and marrow findings supported B-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, and warming the sample to 37 °C should disperse the agglutinates.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are orderly linear stacks of red cells like coins, whereas agglutinates are irregular grape-like clumps that disperse on warming.
CLL cells are small with coarse block-like chromatin and smudge cells, whereas prolymphocytes are larger with a prominent central nucleolus (>55% prolymphocytes).
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and no red cell agglutination at room temperature.
Mantle cell lymphoma can mimic prolymphocytes but is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
